description: Inner-benchmark tasks consumed by the PromptPotter connector's extract_experiment hook. Each task is one inner-cycle invocation = one outer sample; the outer L1's score for a candidate is a COMPOSED fitness (per campaign.json::scoring, computed by inner_recursion._compute_proxies) — not one number thrown away from a signal-rich campaign. Shape = lift core x bounded quality modulator x efficiency modulator: (0.5*(first_round_delta+1)/2 + 0.5*(headroom_lift+1)/2) * max(0.6, cleanliness*diversity_health) * (0.7 + 0.3*clamp(delta_per_dollar/6)). GOVERNING LAW: every term must carry a CANDIDATE GRADIENT (vary across the meta-prompt candidates being compared) — the two proxies retired earlier (rounds_to_N, a per-seed cost multiplier) died precisely because they were constant across candidates or a seed-property, so a flat term earns nothing and is cut in tuning. LIFT CORE: first_round_delta (early speed) + headroom_lift = best-discovered depth normalized by the task's own headroom (target-origin), which removes origin-strength bias so a config compares across inner tasks of different difficulty. Both read the inner cycle's best-DISCOVERED candidate (θ-LCB of the best candidate the inner search FOUND, discounted by its SE), NOT the best it CROWNED — the crowned frontier lags at small inner budgets, so the discovered level is the sensitive signal. The whole trajectory is ONE space (θ-implied ability where the ruler is warm, else raw accuracy) so no delta subtracts across scales; levels are NOT floored at origin, so a regressing meta-prompt yields a negative delta the outer steers away from (recentred (delta+1)/2 so regression<no-op<improvement stay distinct). QUALITY MODULATOR (penalties modulate, never dilute — floored at 0.6 so a broken campaign is discounted <=40%, never sign-flipped): cleanliness = 1 - mean-per-round(inner degraded/unscoreable rate + the outer meta-prompt's own malformed-output rate); diversity_health = 1 - mean-per-round(no-op+duplicate share) penalizes mode collapse. EFFICIENCY MODULATOR: delta_per_dollar = best-depth / inner cost_usd — candidate-specific numerator, so (unlike the retired per-seed cost multiplier) it carries a gradient: a verbose meta-prompt burns more for the same lift and scores lower. EMITTED BUT HELD OUT of the v1 formula until a validation read confirms candidate gradient here (avoids re-baking a flat term): rounds_improved_frac, delta_per_candidate, delta_per_second, after_N_rounds_delta (superseded by headroom_lift in the core but kept as a raw observation), and rounds_to_N (constant while origin<target is unreachable in 2 rounds; still narrated). ACCEPTANCE is empirical: the composed fitness must hold the C3 gate proxy_lift_corr>=0.6 — a term that degrades it is dropped. Inner benchmark = justlogic depth-6/7 (~0.44 origin, clear headroom; gsm8k retired — its origin aces target). Target 0.60; paper ceiling on this stratum ~0.81. n_samples_per_inner_round = 24, scored IN FULL per candidate (inner_recursion sets sp_budget_ttest = bank size): drawing more than we score just widens the θ-LCB and starves the signal, so draw == measure. 2 inner rounds x 2 inner variants (inner_n_variants) is the screening geometry; MUST be >=2, else the `levels` trajectory has a single entry and first_round_delta==headroom source collapse to one number. PANEL = 6 seeds: trimmed from 8 to sit AT the elimination_n_min (6) coverage floor — ~1.4x faster per round (paired with n_variants 3->2) for a quicker trend read, with ZERO flaky-tail margin (one errored inner campaign drops the round under the floor). Restore to 8 for a decisive/distributable run. Added depth roughly doubles inner spend, so the outer spend cap (campaign.json::spend_budget_usd) is sized to fit.
